post.description:
Create an org with the caller as its owner. An `Idempotency-Key` header makes a retry
return the first response instead of creating a second org (spec §7).

delete.description:
Delete the org, its members, invitations and everything it owns. The caller must type
the org's name (spec §7), sent as `?confirm_name=`: a DELETE can't carry a body through
CloudFront. The audit log keeps its records.

get.description: The org's audit events, newest first, a page at a time (spec §7's cursor pagination).

delete.description: Remove a member, or leave when `{user_id}` is the caller (spec §6.4).

post.description: Join an org with an invitation's token, from the link's fragment (spec §6.3).

Register a file and get a presigned PUT for it, valid for 5 minutes. It counts against
the org's 20 uploads a day; an `Idempotency-Key` makes a retry return the same upload.

get.description: The org's uploads, newest first, a page at a time.
One upload: its status and, once analyzed, its statistics.

The org's findings, newest first, or most severe first and then newest with
`sort=severity` (Plan 6b). Filters, combined: any of the given statuses, severity, detector,
upload, the assignee (`me` or `none`) and `since` a moment (Plan 6d). A cursor works only
with the order it was made for.

One finding with its evidence, techniques and events. Its `ETag` is the version that
triage (Plan 4c) will require in `If-Match`.

patch.description:
Change the finding's status, its assignee, or both. `If-Match` must carry the `ETag` of
the version the caller read: without it the answer is 428, and if someone changed the
finding since, 412 with the current `ETag`.

post.description:
Add a comment to the finding's history. An `Idempotency-Key` makes a retry return the
same comment instead of posting it twice. The audit log records that a comment was made,
never its text.

Explain the finding again: 202 when it's queued, or 200 with the answer when it's already
explained for the current model and prompt.

put.description:
Rate one of the finding's explanations up or down; a new rating replaces the last. Only an
explanation that succeeded can be rated (409 otherwise).

get.description: The last `days` UTC days of AI use (30 unless asked; at most 90), newest first.

One ATT&CK technique (`T1046`, `T1110.001`) from the version NetTriage ships, with
MITRE's notice and license.

AiAnalysisOut.title: AiAnalysisOut
AiAnalysisOut.description: AI-generated: the UI labels it so, with the model and prompt version (spec §8.4).

FeedbackIn.title: FeedbackIn
FeedbackIn.description: A reader's rating of an explanation: `up` or `down` (spec §7).

RerunOut.title: RerunOut
RerunOut.description:
`queued` (202): the triage worker explains the finding again. `explained` (200): its
latest analysis for the current model, prompt and input already succeeded, so that answer is
returned and nothing is spent.

TriageIn.title: TriageIn
TriageIn.description:
A status, an assignee, or both. `"assignee_id": null` unassigns; leaving a field out
leaves it as it is.

UsageOut.title: UsageOut
UsageOut.description: Newest day first. Days without a model call aren't listed.
